source.text: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹתאֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A song for the ascents. I lift up my eyes to the mountains; from where will come my help?

en.L: A song for the ascents. \q I lift up my eyes to the mountains; \q from where will my help come?
en.B: A song of ascents. \q I look up to the mountains. \q Where will my help come from?
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. \q I look up at the hills. \q Where can I find help?

vi.L: Bài ca cho những lần đi lên. \q Tôi ngước mắt lên các núi; \q sự giúp đỡ của tôi sẽ đến từ đâu?
vi.B: Bài ca đi lên. \q Tôi nhìn lên núi đồi. \q Sự giúp đỡ cho tôi sẽ từ đâu đến?
vi.R: Bài ca cho cuộc hành trình lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Tôi nhìn lên những ngọn đồi. \q Tôi có thể tìm sự giúp đỡ ở đâu?

ko.L: 올라감을 위한 노래. \q 내가 산들을 향해 내 눈을 든다. \q 나의 도움이 어디에서 오겠는가?
ko.B: 올라가며 부르는 노래. \q 나는 산들을 바라본다. \q 나를 도울 힘은 어디에서 오는가?
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래. \q 나는 언덕들을 올려다본다. \q 어디에서 도움을 얻을 수 있을까?

fr.L: Cantique pour les montées. \q Je lève mes yeux vers les montagnes : \q d’où viendra mon secours ?
fr.B: Cantique des montées. \q Je regarde vers les montagnes. \q D’où me viendra le secours ?
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. \q Je lève les yeux vers les collines. \q Où trouver de l’aide ?

sw.L: Wimbo kwa ajili ya kupanda. \q Ninainua macho yangu kwa milima; \q msaada wangu utakuja kutoka wapi?
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. \q Ninatazama juu milimani. \q Msaada wangu utanijia kutoka wapi?
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. \q Ninatazama juu kwenye vilima. \q Nitapata msaada wapi?

es.L: Cántico para las subidas. \q Alzo mis ojos hacia los montes; \q ¿de dónde vendrá mi ayuda?
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. \q Miro hacia los montes. \q ¿De dónde me vendrá la ayuda?
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. \q Levanto la vista hacia las colinas. \q ¿Dónde puedo encontrar ayuda?

pt.L: Cântico dos degraus. \q Ergo os meus olhos para os montes; \q de onde virá a minha ajuda?
pt.B: Cântico das subidas. \q Olho para o alto, para os montes. \q De onde virá a ajuda de que preciso?
pt.R: Canção para a subida a Jerusalém. \q Olho para as colinas lá no alto. \q Onde vou encontrar ajuda?

am.L: ለመውጣት የሚሆን መዝሙር። \q ዓይኖቼን ወደ ተራሮቹ አቀናለሁ፤ \q እርዳታዬ ከየት ይመጣል?
am.B: የመውጣት መዝሙር። \q ቀና ብዬ ተራሮቹን እመለከታለሁ። \q እርዳታዬ ከየት ይመጣል?
am.R: የመውጣት መዝሙር፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጡ የሚዘመር። \q ቀና ብዬ ኮረብቶቹን አያለሁ። \q እርዳታ ከየት አገኛለሁ?

hi.L: चढ़ाई का गीत। \q मैं अपनी आँखें पहाड़ों की ओर उठाता हूँ; \q मेरी सहायता कहाँ से आएगी?
hi.B: चढ़ाई का गीत। \q मैं पहाड़ों की ओर देखता हूँ। \q मुझे सहायता कहाँ से मिलेगी?
hi.R: यरूशलेम की ओर जाने की यात्रा का गीत। \q मैं पहाड़ियों की ओर देखता हूँ। \q मुझे मदद कहाँ मिल सकती है?

ru.L: Песнь восхождения. \q Поднимаю глаза мои к горам; \q откуда придёт помощь моя?
ru.B: Песнь восхождения. \q Я смотрю на горы. \q Откуда придёт мне помощь?
ru.R: Песня для пути в Иерусалим. \q Я смотрю на холмы. \q Где мне найти помощь?

uk.L: Пісня для сходжень. \q Я підношу мої очі до гір; \q звідки прийде моя допомога?
uk.B: Пісня сходжень. \q Я дивлюся вгору, на гори. \q Звідки прийде мені допомога?
uk.R: Пісня для подорожі вгору до Єрусалима. \q Я дивлюся на пагорби. \q Де мені знайти допомогу?

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: for the ascents
decisions.reason: This title alone has "a song for the ascents" (le-ma'alot) rather than "the song of the ascents". The sense is the same; Literal shows the difference.

decisions.choice: a question: from where?
alternatives: a statement: the hills, from where my help comes
decisions.reason: The word (me'ayin) asks "from where?", and verse 2 gives the answer. Older renderings that read it as "from which my help comes" make the hills the source of help, which verse 2 corrects.

decisions.choice: the mountains: the hills on the way to Jerusalem
alternatives: hills of danger and false worship
decisions.reason: A pilgrim on the road sees the hills ahead: the hills around Jerusalem where God's house stands (87:1; 125:2), but also hills where robbers hid and where other gods were worshiped (Jeremiah 3:23). Either way the question is answered in verse 2: help comes from the LORD who made the hills.

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

decisions.choice: "Bài ca cho những lần đi lên" (L); "Bài ca đi lên" (B)
decisions.reason: The title says only "ascents"; it is probably a pilgrim song for going up to Jerusalem (see the meaning decision), but Literal and Balanced keep the title's own word, and Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "올라감을 위한 노래" (L), "올라가며 부르는 노래" (B), "예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the title most likely means, a song sung on the way up (meaning decision), without naming the temple, which the Hebrew does not; Readable names Jerusalem as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: The singer speaks in the plain written style and calls himself "나" (verses 1-2)
decisions.reason: Verses 1-2 are not addressed to God, so the plain written style holds (style guide section 7a); see verse 3 for the voice that answers.

decisions.choice: "Cantique pour les montées" at Literal; "Cantique des montées" at Balanced
decisions.reason: Only this title has "for the ascents"; Literal shows the difference, as the English does, and Balanced keeps the common title of Psalms 120-134.

decisions.choice: "Wimbo kwa ajili ya kupanda" (a song for the going up) at Literal
alternatives: "Wimbo wa kupanda", as in the other titles
decisions.reason: Only this title says "for the ascents" rather than "of the ascents" (see the meaning decision). Literal shows the difference; Balanced and Readable use the same title as the other songs of ascents.

decisions.choice: "Cántico para las subidas"
decisions.reason: This title alone says "for the ascents" (meaning decision); Literal shows it with "para", Balanced uses the common title of 120-134.

decisions.choice: Cântico dos degraus (as in 120:1)
decisions.reason: This title alone has "for the ascents" (m3), which the English Literal shows. The sense is the same, so Portuguese keeps the title of the fifteen Songs of Ascents word for word, as set in 120:1, and leaves the small difference to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: A song for the ascents as "ለመውጣት የሚሆን መዝሙር" (L); "የመውጣት መዝሙር" (B, R), the heading of all the Songs of Ascents
decisions.reason: Only this title has the preposition "for" (meaning decision m3); Literal shows it, while Balanced and Readable keep the common heading, Readable with its explanation as in Psalm 120.

decisions.choice: I lift up my eyes as "ዓይኖቼን … አቀናለሁ" (L), "ቀና ብዬ … እመለከታለሁ" (B, R); help as "እርዳታ"
decisions.reason: Psalm 121 is known by heart in an older Amharic wording; the psalm is drafted afresh from the Hebrew, with the plain modern "እርዳታ" for help and its own verbs, so no line repeats that version. No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm: Ethiopic has no capitals.

decisions.choice: "चढ़ाई का गीत", as in the other Songs of Ascents
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has "for the ascents" (meaning m3), which the English Literal keeps. Hindi keeps the one title used for Psalms 120-134, as the poetry note's table has it, since the sense is the same pilgrim song.

decisions.choice: Песнь восхождения (L, B); Песня для пути в Иерусалим (R)
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one form of the title per level through the Songs of Ascents. Here the Hebrew reads "for the ascents" (m3); Literal keeps the one title form rather than make a second one for a small difference of preposition.

source.text: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: My help [is] from with YHWH, maker of heaven and earth.

en.L: My help [is] from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q maker of heaven and earth.
en.B: My help is from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the one who made heaven and earth.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who helps me. \q He made the heavens and the earth.

vi.L: Sự giúp đỡ của tôi [đến] từ nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q Đấng làm nên trời và đất.
vi.B: Sự giúp đỡ của tôi đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q Đấng đã tạo nên trời và đất.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng giúp đỡ tôi. \q Ngài đã dựng nên trời và đất.

ko.L: 나의 도움은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 [온다]. \q 하늘과 땅을 지으신 분이시다.
ko.B: 내 도움은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 온다. \q 그분은 하늘과 땅을 만드신 분이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도와주신다. \q 그분께서 하늘과 땅을 만드셨다.

fr.L: Mon secours [vient] d’auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q qui a fait le ciel et la terre.
fr.B: Mon secours vient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q celui qui a fait le ciel et la terre.
fr.R: C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui m’aide. \q Il a fait le ciel et la terre.

sw.L: Msaada wangu [unatoka] kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q muumba wa mbingu na nchi.
sw.B: Msaada wangu unatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyeumba mbingu na nchi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayenisaidia. \q Yeye aliumba mbingu na dunia.

es.L: Mi ayuda [viene] {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q hacedor de los cielos y de la tierra.
es.B: Mi ayuda viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q el que hizo los cielos y la tierra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es quien me ayuda. \q Él hizo los cielos y la tierra.

pt.L: A minha ajuda [vem] de junto {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q o que fez os céus e a terra.
pt.B: É {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que me vem a ajuda, \q daquele que fez o céu e a terra.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é quem me ajuda. \q Ele fez os céus e a terra.

am.B: እርዳታዬ የሚመጣው {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ነው፤ \q ሰማይንና ምድርን ከሠራው።
am.R: የሚረዳኝ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። \q እርሱ ሰማይንና ምድርን ሠራ።

hi.L: मेरी सहायता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से [है], \q जो आकाश और पृथ्वी के बनानेवाले [हैं]।
hi.B: मेरी सहायता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से है, \q जिन्होंने आकाश और पृथ्वी को बनाया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही मेरी मदद करते हैं। \q उन्होंने आकाश और धरती को बनाया।

ru.L: Помощь моя — от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q Творца неба и земли.
ru.B: Моя помощь — от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q который сотворил небо и землю.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — тот, кто помогает мне. \q Он сотворил небеса и землю.

uk.L: Моя допомога — від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q творця неба й землі.
uk.B: Моя допомога — від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q того, хто створив небо й землю.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — той, хто допомагає мені. \q Він створив небо й землю.

decisions.choice: from with: from the presence of
decisions.reason: The double preposition (me'im) means "from beside" or "from the presence of": help comes from where the LORD is.

decisions.choice: maker of heaven and earth: the creator of all
decisions.reason: The LORD is named as the one who made everything (Genesis 1:1; 14:19). Help from the creator of the whole world is greater than any help the hills, or anything in them, could give. The same words close 124:8 and 134:3 and appear in 115:15.

decisions.choice: YHWH is {{divine_name:주|야훼}} with the particle outside the span ({{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서)
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a); this holds for the whole psalm.

decisions.choice: o que fez os céus e a terra (L); aquele que fez o céu e a terra (B); que fez o céu e a terra (R)
alternatives: criador do céu e da terra
decisions.reason: The title of the creator (m2) comes back in 124:8 and 134:3; each level keeps one wording for it in all three. Literal keeps the plural of the Hebrew "heavens" and the participle as "o que fez"; the familiar "criador do céu e da terra" is avoided so that the line is not taken over from a known version. "Ajuda" renders the plain Hebrew word for help (also 124:8).

records.literal_gloss: Not may he give to slip your foot; not may he slumber, your keeper.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not allow your foot to slip; \q may your keeper not slumber.
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never let your foot stumble; \q may the one who guards you never doze.
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keep you from falling. \q May the one who protects you stay awake.

vi.L: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để chân bạn trượt ngã; \q nguyện Đấng gìn giữ bạn không ngủ gật.
vi.B: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ để chân bạn vấp ngã; \q nguyện Đấng canh giữ bạn không hề chợp mắt.
vi.R: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ bạn khỏi vấp ngã. \q Nguyện Đấng bảo vệ bạn luôn tỉnh thức.

ko.L: 그분께서 네 발이 미끄러지도록 두지 않으시기를. \q 너를 지키시는 분께서 졸지 않으시기를.
ko.B: 그분께서 네 발이 결코 헛디디지 않게 하시기를, \q 너를 지키시는 분께서 결코 졸지 않으시기를 빈다.
ko.R: 그분께서 너를 넘어지지 않게 지켜 주시기를. \q 너를 보호하시는 분께서 늘 깨어 계시기를.

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laisse pas ton pied chanceler ; \q que celui qui te garde ne sommeille pas !
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laisse jamais ton pied trébucher ; \q que celui qui veille sur toi ne s’assoupisse jamais !
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’empêche de tomber ! \q Que celui qui te protège reste éveillé !

sw.L: Asiuache mguu wako uteleze; \q mlinzi wako asisinzie.
sw.B: Asiruhusu kamwe mguu wako ujikwae; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayekulinda asisinzie kamwe.
sw.R: Na akuzuie usianguke. \q Na yule anayekulinda akae macho.

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no permita que tu pie resbale; \q que no se duerma tu guardián.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nunca deje que tropiece tu pie; \q que nunca cabecee el que te cuida.
es.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te libre de caer. \q Que el que te protege se mantenga despierto.

pt.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixe o seu pé escorregar; \q que não cochile o seu guarda.
pt.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nunca deixe o seu pé tropeçar; \q que nunca cochile aquele que vela por você.
pt.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixe você cair. \q Que aquele que cuida de você fique sempre acordado.

am.B: እግርህ እንዲሰናከል ከቶ አይተው፤ \q የሚጠብቅህም ከቶ አያንጎላጅ።

hi.L: वे तुम्हारे पाँव को फिसलने न दें; \q तुम्हारे रखवाले न ऊँघें।
hi.B: वे तुम्हारे पाँव को कभी लड़खड़ाने न दें; \q तुम्हारे रक्षक कभी न ऊँघें।
hi.R: वे तुम्हें गिरने से बचाए रखें। \q तुम्हारी हिफ़ाज़त करनेवाले जागते रहें।

ru.L: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не даст ноге твоей поскользнуться; \q пусть не дремлет хранящий тебя.
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} никогда не даст тебе оступиться; \q пусть никогда не задремлет тот, кто охраняет тебя.
ru.R: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не даст тебе упасть. \q Пусть тот, кто защищает тебя, будет всегда начеку.

uk.L: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не дасть твоїй нозі посковзнутися; \q нехай не дрімає твій охоронець.
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ніколи не дасть твоїй нозі спіткнутися; \q нехай ніколи не задрімає той, хто тебе стереже.
uk.R: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} береже тебе від падіння. \q Нехай той, хто тебе захищає, не спить.

decisions.choice: a wish: may he not ...
decisions.reason: The negative used here ('al) usually goes with a wish or a request, "may he not". A second voice seems to speak to the pilgrim, blessing him; verse 4 then answers the wish with a firm "he will not" (lo'). Many read verse 3 as a promise already.

decisions.choice: your foot slip: a fall, disaster
decisions.reason: A slipping foot is a picture of falling into trouble (38:17; 66:9), and on a mountain road it is also a real danger.

decisions.choice: your: one person addressed
decisions.reason: From here on the psalm speaks to "you" (singular): another voice, perhaps a priest or a fellow pilgrim, answers the one who spoke in verses 1-2, or the psalmist speaks to himself.

decisions.choice: keep (L); guard (B); protect (R)
decisions.reason: The verb shamar comes six times in this psalm (verses 3-8). Each level keeps one English word for it throughout, so that the repetition, which carries the psalm, can be heard.

decisions.choice: "bạn" for the one person spoken to in verses 3-8
decisions.reason: The voice turns to speak to one person, man or woman, young or old. "bạn" is the neutral modern word that fits anyone; "con" would make the speaker a parent or priest, "anh" fixes age and sex, and "ngươi" is archaic.

decisions.choice: "gìn giữ" (L), "canh giữ" (B), "bảo vệ" (R) for the psalm's repeated "keep"
decisions.reason: The verb runs through the psalm six times; each level keeps one word for it throughout, as the English does (keep, guard, protect).

decisions.choice: The one addressed is "너", in the plain style (해라체); the wish is "-기를"
decisions.reason: From verse 3 a voice speaks to one person (meaning decision m3), a blessing to a fellow pilgrim or the singer's own heart; 해라체 with 너 is the plain voice of Korean poetry and of a blessing spoken to an equal. "그대" is a possible literary alternative.

decisions.choice: "지키다" (L, B) and "보호하다" (R) for the keeper and keeping in verses 3-8; no deity_pronoun spans (Korean has no capitals)
decisions.reason: One verb runs through the psalm (keep) and Korean keeps one at each level so the repetition is heard; "지키다" covers both keep and guard. God is 그분 with the honorific (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "garder" (Literal), "veiller sur" (Balanced), "protéger" (Readable) for shamar throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The English varies the verb by level (keep, guard, protect); French does the same, so that each level reads naturally. The Hebrew uses one verb six times, which Literal shows by keeping "garder" each time.

decisions.choice: "kulinda" (mlinzi, anayekulinda) at every level for the Hebrew shamar, through this psalm
decisions.reason: The English varies its word by level (keep, guard, protect). Swahili "kulinda" already means to keep watch over and protect, in plain and careful speech alike, so one word serves every level and keeps the psalm's six repetitions of the same Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: guardián, guardar (L); cuidar (B); proteger (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shomer, used six times in this psalm, is one who keeps watch over someone. Each level uses one Spanish word throughout the psalm, as the English uses keep, guard and protect.

decisions.choice: você, o seu (verses 3-8)
decisions.reason: From verse 3 another voice speaks to the pilgrim (m3), one person to another, so Portuguese says "você", as Psalm 91 does for its words of assurance; "tu" is kept for words to God.

decisions.choice: guardar, o guarda (L); velar por (B); cuidar de (R)
decisions.reason: As in English (r-en-1), each level keeps one verb for shamar through verses 3-8, so the repetition can be heard. Literal says "guardar", the plain sense; Balanced "velar por", watching over someone with care, as the Portuguese of the priestly blessing has it at Balanced (Numbers 6:24); Readable "cuidar de", the everyday verb.

decisions.choice: keep (shamar) as "ጠበቀ" and keeper as "ጠባቂ" at every level, all six times in the psalm
alternatives: "ጠበቀ" (L), "ጋረደ" (B), "ከለለ" (R), following the English keep, guard, protect
decisions.reason: The one verb carries the psalm (verses 3-8), and "ጠበቀ" says keep, guard and protect at once in Amharic, so every level can repeat it as the Hebrew does; it is also the word for shamar in Psalm 119.

decisions.choice: a wish ("አይፍቀድ", "አይተው", "ይጠብቅህ"), not a promise
decisions.reason: The verbs are wishes (meaning decision m1), answered by the promise of verse 4; the Amharic jussive keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God spoken of takes the honorific plural ("वे ... न दें", "रखवाले").

decisions.choice: "रखवाला", "रखवाली करना" (L); "रक्षक", "रक्षा करना" (B); "हिफ़ाज़त करना" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb shamar comes six times in verses 3-8, and the repetition carries the psalm. Each level keeps one Hindi word for it throughout, as the English does with keep, guard and protect. The psalm speaks to one person (meaning m3), with "तुम".

decisions.choice: хранить (L); охранять (B); защищать (R)
decisions.reason: Shamar comes six times in verses 3-8 and carries the psalm; as the English does, each level keeps one Russian verb for it throughout (хранящий, хранитель, сохранит at Literal).

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, not he will slumber and not he will sleep, [the] keeper of Israel.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not slumber and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not sleep, \q the keeper of Israel.
en.B: Indeed, the one who guards Israel \q never dozes off and never sleeps.
en.R: The one who protects Israel never gets sleepy. \q He never sleeps.

vi.L: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không ngủ gật và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không ngủ, \q Đấng gìn giữ Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Thật vậy, Đấng canh giữ Y-sơ-ra-ên không bao giờ chợp mắt, \q cũng chẳng hề ngủ.
vi.R: Đấng bảo vệ Y-sơ-ra-ên không bao giờ buồn ngủ. \q Ngài không bao giờ ngủ.

ko.L: 보아라, 그분은 졸지도 않으시고 주무시지도 않으신다, \q 이스라엘을 지키시는 분은.
ko.B: 참으로 그분은 졸지도 주무시지도 않으신다, \q 이스라엘을 지키시는 그분은.
ko.R: 이스라엘을 보호하시는 분은 결코 졸지 않으신다. \q 그분은 한 번도 주무시지 않으신다.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne sommeille pas et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne dort pas, \q celui qui garde Israël.
fr.B: Non, celui qui veille sur Israël \q ne s’assoupit pas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne dort jamais.
fr.R: Celui qui protège Israël n’a jamais sommeil. \q Il ne dort jamais.

sw.L: Tazama, hatasinzia wala hatalala, \q mlinzi wa Israeli.
sw.B: Hakika, anayemlinda Israeli \q hasinzii kamwe wala halali.
sw.R: Yule anayemlinda Israeli hasikii usingizi kamwe. \q Halali kamwe.

es.L: Mira, no se adormecerá ni se dormirá \q el guardián de Israel.
es.B: Ciertamente, el que cuida a Israel \q nunca cabecea ni se duerme.
es.R: El que protege a Israel nunca tiene sueño. \q Nunca se duerme.

pt.L: Eis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não cochilará e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não dormirá, \q o guarda de Israel.
pt.B: De fato, aquele que vela por Israel \q nunca cochila nem dorme.
pt.R: Aquele que cuida de Israel nunca fica com sono. \q Ele nunca dorme.

am.B: በእርግጥም እስራኤልን የሚጠብቀው \q ከቶ አያንጎላጅም፤ እንቅልፍም አይወስደውም።
am.R: የእስራኤል ጠባቂ እንቅልፍ አይጫጫነውም። \q ፈጽሞ አይተኛም።

hi.L: देखो, वे न ऊँघेंगे और न सोएँगे, \q इस्राएल के रखवाले।
hi.B: सचमुच, इस्राएल के रक्षक \q न कभी ऊँघते हैं, न कभी सोते हैं।
hi.R: इस्राएल की हिफ़ाज़त करनेवाले कभी ऊँघते नहीं। \q वे कभी नहीं सोते।

ru.L: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не задремлет и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не уснёт, \q хранящий Израиль.
ru.B: Да, тот, кто охраняет Израиль, \q никогда не дремлет и никогда не спит.
ru.R: Того, кто защищает Израиль, никогда не клонит в сон. \q Он никогда не спит.

uk.L: Ось {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не задрімає і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не засне, \q охоронець Ізраїля.
uk.B: Справді, той, хто стереже Ізраїль, \q ніколи не дрімає і ніколи не спить.
uk.R: Той, хто захищає Ізраїль, ніколи не хоче спати. \q Він ніколи не спить.

decisions.choice: look, he will not: the answer to the wish
decisions.reason: "Look" (hinneh) points to something certain. What verse 3 wished ("may he not slumber") is now stated as fact with the plain negative (lo').

decisions.choice: a God who does not sleep
decisions.reason: Elijah mocked Baal as a god who might be asleep (1 Kings 18:27); the God of Israel never needs to be woken. When the psalms call on God to wake up (44:24), they speak as people who feel forgotten, not of a God who sleeps.

decisions.choice: keep (L); guard (B); protect (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

decisions.choice: хранящий (L); охраняет (B); защищает (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

source.text: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is] your keeper; YHWH [is] your shade at [the] hand of your right.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] your keeper; \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] your shade at your right hand.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who guards you; \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is shade at your right side.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} protects you. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} stands next to you like shade that keeps off the heat.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng gìn giữ bạn; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] bóng che bạn ở bên tay phải bạn.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng canh giữ bạn; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là bóng mát che chở bên phải bạn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo vệ bạn. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng ngay cạnh bạn như bóng mát che cái nắng gay gắt.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 너를 지키시는 분이시다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 네 오른손 곁의 너의 그늘이시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 너를 지키시는 분, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 네 오른편에서 그늘이 되어 주신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 보호하신다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네 곁에 서서 뜨거운 햇볕을 가려 주는 그늘이 되신다.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] celui qui te garde ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] ton ombre à ta main droite.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est celui qui veille sur toi ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est une ombre à ta droite.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te protège. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se tient à côté de toi, comme une ombre qui protège de la chaleur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mlinzi wako; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kivuli chako mkononi mwako wa kuume.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayekulinda; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kivuli upande wako wa kulia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakulinda. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko karibu nawe kama kivuli kinachokukinga na jua kali.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] tu guardián; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] tu sombra a tu mano derecha.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el que te cuida; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es sombra a tu lado derecho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te protege. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está a tu lado como una sombra que te libra del calor.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] o seu guarda; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] a sua sombra à sua mão direita.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é aquele que vela por você; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é sombra ao seu lado direito.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} cuida de você. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fica ao seu lado como uma sombra que protege do calor.

am.B: የሚጠብቅህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በቀኝህ በኩል ጥላ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጠብቅሃል። \q ሙቀትን እንደሚከላከል ጥላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከአጠገብህ ይቆማል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे रखवाले [हैं]; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे दाहिने हाथ पर तुम्हारी छाया [हैं]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही तुम्हारे रक्षक हैं; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी दाहिनी ओर छाया हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी हिफ़ाज़त करते हैं। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} छाया की तरह तुम्हारे पास खड़े रहते हैं, जो धूप की तपन से बचाती है।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — хранитель твой; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — тень твоя по правую руку твою.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — тот, кто охраняет тебя; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — тень по правую руку от тебя.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} защищает тебя. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} стоит рядом с тобой, как тень, которая спасает от жары.

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — твій охоронець; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — твоя тінь при твоїй правиці.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — той, хто тебе стереже; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — тінь праворуч від тебе.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захищає тебе. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} стоїть поруч із тобою, як тінь, що береже від спеки.

decisions.choice: shade: protection from the burning sun
decisions.reason: In a hot land, shade means relief and safety (Isaiah 25:4; 32:2). The picture leads into verse 6.

decisions.choice: at your right hand: close beside you
decisions.reason: The right side is where a helper or defender stands (16:8; 109:31; 110:5).

decisions.choice: keep (L); guard (B); protect (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

decisions.choice: stands next to you like shade that keeps off the heat
alternatives: your shade at your right hand
decisions.reason: Readable explains both pictures (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: хранитель (L); охраняет (B); защищает (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

records.literal_gloss: By day the sun not will strike you, and [the] moon by night.

en.L: By day the sun will not strike you, \q nor the moon by night.
en.B: By day the sun will not beat down on you, \q and by night the moon will do you no harm.
en.R: The sun will not hurt you during the day. \q The moon will not hurt you at night.

vi.L: Ban ngày mặt trời sẽ không đánh vào bạn, \q mặt trăng ban đêm cũng không.
vi.B: Ban ngày mặt trời sẽ không thiêu đốt bạn, \q ban đêm mặt trăng cũng chẳng làm hại bạn.
vi.R: Ban ngày mặt trời sẽ không làm hại bạn. \q Ban đêm mặt trăng cũng không làm hại bạn.

ko.L: 낮에 해가 너를 치지 않을 것이요, \q 밤에 달도 [너를 치지 않을 것이다].
ko.B: 낮에는 해가 너를 내리쬐어 상하게 하지 않고, \q 밤에도 달이 너에게 해를 끼치지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 낮에는 해가 너를 아프게 하지 못할 것이다. \q 밤에는 달이 너를 해치지 못할 것이다.

fr.L: Le jour, le soleil ne te frappera pas, \q ni la lune la nuit.
fr.B: Le jour, le soleil ne t’accablera pas, \q et la nuit, la lune ne te fera aucun mal.
fr.R: Le soleil ne te fera pas de mal pendant le jour. \q La lune ne te fera pas de mal pendant la nuit.

sw.L: Mchana jua halitakupiga, \q wala mwezi usiku.
sw.B: Mchana jua halitakuchoma, \q na usiku mwezi hautakudhuru.
sw.R: Jua halitakuumiza wakati wa mchana. \q Mwezi hautakuumiza wakati wa usiku.

es.L: De día el sol no te herirá, \q ni la luna de noche.
es.B: De día el sol no caerá con fuerza sobre ti, \q y de noche la luna no te hará daño.
es.R: El sol no te hará daño durante el día. \q La luna no te hará daño por la noche.

pt.L: Durante o dia o sol não ferirá você, \q nem a lua durante a noite.
pt.B: De dia, o sol não vai castigar você \q e, de noite, a lua não lhe fará mal.
pt.R: O sol não vai fazer mal a você durante o dia. \q A lua não vai fazer mal a você à noite.

am.B: በቀን ፀሐይ አትጎዳህም፤ \q በሌሊትም ጨረቃ ክፉ አታደርግብህም።
am.R: ፀሐይ በቀን አትጎዳህም። \q ጨረቃ በሌሊት አትጎዳህም።

hi.L: दिन को सूर्य तुम्हें न मारेगा, \q न रात को चंद्रमा।
hi.B: दिन में सूर्य तुम्हें न झुलसाएगा, \q और रात को चंद्रमा तुम्हें कोई हानि न पहुँचाएगा।
hi.R: दिन में सूरज तुम्हें नुक़सान नहीं पहुँचाएगा। \q रात को चाँद तुम्हें नुक़सान नहीं पहुँचाएगा।

ru.L: Днём солнце не поразит тебя, \q ни луна ночью.
ru.B: Днём солнце не опалит тебя, \q и ночью луна не причинит тебе вреда.
ru.R: Солнце не повредит тебе днём. \q Луна не повредит тебе ночью.

uk.L: Удень сонце не вразить тебе, \q ані місяць уночі.
uk.B: Удень сонце не пектиме тебе, \q і вночі місяць не заподіє тобі шкоди.
uk.R: Сонце не зашкодить тобі вдень. \q Місяць не зашкодить тобі вночі.

decisions.choice: the sun strike you: sunstroke
decisions.reason: The heat of the sun could strike a traveler down (2 Kings 4:18-20; Jonah 4:8; Isaiah 49:10).

decisions.choice: the moon: dangers of the night
decisions.reason: People of the time believed that the moon could cause illness, and the night was a time of danger. Day and night together mean all the time: no hour is outside the LORD's care.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH will keep you from all evil; he will keep your soul.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will keep you from all evil; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will keep your soul.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will guard you against every harm; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will guard your very life.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will protect you from every danger. \q He will protect your life.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ gìn giữ bạn khỏi mọi điều ác; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ gìn giữ linh hồn bạn.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ canh giữ bạn khỏi mọi tai họa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ canh giữ chính mạng sống bạn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bảo vệ bạn khỏi mọi nguy hiểm. \q Ngài sẽ bảo vệ mạng sống bạn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 악에서 너를 지키실 것이다. \q 그분께서 네 영혼을 지키실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 온갖 해로부터 너를 지키시고, \q 네 목숨을 지켜 주실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 위험에서 너를 보호하실 것이다. \q 네 목숨을 보호하실 것이다.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te gardera de tout mal ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} gardera ton âme.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veillera sur toi contre tout malheur ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veillera sur ta vie même.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te protégera de tout danger. \q Il protégera ta vie.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda kutoka kwa kila baya; \q atailinda nafsi yako.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda dhidi ya kila dhara; \q atayalinda maisha yako kabisa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda usipatwe na hatari yoyote. \q Atayalinda maisha yako.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te guardará de todo mal; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} guardará tu alma.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te cuidará de todo daño; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuidará tu vida misma.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te protegerá de todo peligro. \q Él protegerá tu vida.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} guardará você contra todo mal; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} guardará a sua alma.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai velar por você, para que nenhum mal o atinja; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai velar pela sua própria vida.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai cuidar de você em todo perigo. \q Ele vai cuidar da sua vida.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከማንኛውም ክፉ ይጠብቅሃል፤ \q ነፍስህን እርሱ ይጠብቃል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጉዳት ሁሉ ይጠብቅሃል፤ \q ሕይወትህንም እርሱ ይጠብቃል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सारी बुराई से तुम्हारी रखवाली करेंगे; \q वे तुम्हारे प्राण की रखवाली करेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हर हानि से तुम्हारी रक्षा करेंगे; \q वे तुम्हारे जीवन की रक्षा करेंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हर ख़तरे से तुम्हारी हिफ़ाज़त करेंगे। \q वे तुम्हारी जान की हिफ़ाज़त करेंगे।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сохранит тебя от всякого зла; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сохранит душу твою.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет охранять тебя от всякой беды; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет охранять саму твою жизнь.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} защитит тебя от всякой опасности. \q Он защитит твою жизнь.

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} берегтиме тебе від усякого зла; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} берегтиме твою душу.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} стерегтиме тебе від кожної біди; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} стерегтиме саме твоє життя.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захистить тебе від усякої небезпеки. \q Він захистить твоє життя.

decisions.choice: evil: harm, disaster
decisions.reason: The word (ra') covers both wrongdoing and the harm that comes on a person. Here it is harm and disaster of every kind.

decisions.choice: your soul (L); your life (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life", since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: keep (L); guard (B); protect (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

decisions.choice: "영혼" (L); "목숨" (B, R) for nefesh
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the life that is kept from harm, as the English does; "목숨" is the word kept for this sense (style guide section 6), "생명" being kept for life in the fuller sense.

decisions.choice: душу твою (L); твою жизнь (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is душа at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me", "I" or "life" as the English level does, since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: сохранит (L); будет охранять (B); защитит (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH will keep your going out and your coming in from now and until forever.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will keep your going out and your coming in \q from now and until forever.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will guard you as you set out and as you return, \q from now on and for all time.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will protect you when you leave home and when you come back, \q now and forever.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ gìn giữ sự ra đi của bạn và sự trở vào của bạn, \q từ nay cho đến đời đời.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ canh giữ bạn khi bạn ra đi và khi bạn trở về, \q từ nay cho đến mãi mãi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bảo vệ bạn khi bạn rời nhà và khi bạn trở về, \q bây giờ và mãi mãi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너의 나감과 너의 들어옴을 지키실 것이다, \q 지금부터 영원까지.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네가 길을 떠날 때에도 돌아올 때에도 너를 지키실 것이다, \q 지금부터 영원토록.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네가 집을 나설 때에도, 집에 돌아올 때에도 너를 보호하실 것이다. \q 지금도, 그리고 영원히.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} gardera ta sortie et ton entrée, \q dès maintenant et jusqu’à toujours.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veillera sur toi quand tu pars et quand tu reviens, \q dès maintenant et pour toujours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te protégera quand tu quittes ta maison et quand tu y reviens, \q maintenant et pour toujours.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalinda kutoka kwako na kuingia kwako \q tangu sasa na mpaka milele.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda unapoanza safari na unaporudi, \q tangu sasa na nyakati zote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda unapotoka nyumbani na unaporudi, \q sasa na milele.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} guardará tu salida y tu entrada \q desde ahora y hasta siempre.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te cuidará cuando partas y cuando regreses, \q desde ahora y para siempre.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te protegerá cuando salgas de casa y cuando vuelvas, \q ahora y siempre.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} guardará o seu sair e o seu entrar, \q desde agora e para sempre.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai velar por você quando você partir e quando voltar, \q de agora em diante e para sempre.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai cuidar de você quando você sair de casa e quando voltar, \q agora e sempre.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መውጣትህንና መምጣትህን ይጠብቃል \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም።
am.B: ስትነሣም ስትመለስም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጠብቅሃል፤ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘመናት ሁሉ።
am.R: ከቤትህ ስትወጣም ስትመለስም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጠብቅሃል። \q አሁንም ለዘላለምም።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे जाने और तुम्हारे आने की रखवाली करेंगे \q अब से और सदा तक।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे निकलते और लौटते समय तुम्हारी रक्षा करेंगे, \q अब से लेकर सदा तक।
hi.R: जब तुम घर से निकलोगे और जब लौटोगे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी हिफ़ाज़त करेंगे, \q अभी भी और सदा तक।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сохранит выход твой и вход твой \q отныне и до века.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет охранять тебя, когда ты отправляешься в путь и когда возвращаешься, \q отныне и во все времена.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} защитит тебя, когда ты уходишь из дома и когда возвращаешься, \q сейчас и всегда.

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} берегтиме твій вихід і твій вхід \q відтепер і аж навіки.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} стерегтиме тебе, коли ти вирушаєш і коли повертаєшся, \q віднині й на всі часи.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захищатиме тебе, коли ти йдеш з дому і коли повертаєшся, \q тепер і завжди.

decisions.choice: going out and coming in: all you do
alternatives: the pilgrim's journey there and back
decisions.reason: Going out and coming in is a way of saying all of life's activity, everywhere one goes (Deuteronomy 28:6; 1 Samuel 29:6). For a pilgrim it also fits the journey to Jerusalem and home again.

decisions.choice: keep (L); guard (B); protect (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.

decisions.choice: when you leave home and when you come back
alternatives: your going out and your coming in
decisions.reason: Readable gives the plain sense of the pair (m1).

decisions.choice: going out and coming in in the Hebrew order ("መውጣትህንና መምጣትህን")
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order of the pair, which pictures leaving and returning, all that one does (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: сохранит (L); будет охранять (B); защитит (R)
decisions.reason: As in 121:3.
